item.title: Real-Time System Health Layer: From Metrics to Operational Signals
item.description: A scalable observability layer that turns raw backlog, lag, and throughput numbers into time-based signals—so operators answer “are we keeping up?” without interpreting dashboards.

item.title: Distributed Lock vs Row Lock vs Transaction
item.description: These three mechanisms solve different problems at different layers: distributed locks protect business execution, row locks protect data mutation, and transactions define lock scope and atomicity.
